verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server that connects to agents like Claude or Cursor to work with Klaviyo data, including flow performance reports. Its API is pitched for pulling data for dashboards and performance analysis, authenticated with scoped private keys or OAuth. The core of an agent reading the program and reporting on it is covered, but the evidence only implies some parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of reading audiences (lists/segments) via API or MCP, explicit campaign-results/reporting endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent can assemble a whole-program report.
